wood.label: Wood
wood.description: A knock on wood — the most natural of the set

string.label: Piano
string.description: A hammered piano note — bright enough to enjoy for a long session

mallet.label: Marimba
mallet.description: A softer mallet strike than wood — warm and round

rhythm.label: Rhythm
rhythm.description: Piano marks the three key points, a drum fills the beat between

0.label: Continuous
0.hint: For repeating practice swings with no ball

15.label: 15s
15.hint: For bays where the next ball comes up fast

25.label: 25s
25.hint: Default — time to check the result and reset

40.label: 40s
40.hint: To go through your full pre-shot routine

balanced.label: Even
balanced.headline: Your backswing and downswing take about the same time
balanced.detail: There isn't much difference between the backswing and downswing.

stable.label: Unhurried
stable.headline: You take your time going up
stable.detail: You bring it up slowly, then bring it down precisely.

power.label: Extended
power.headline: You take the backswing further back
power.detail: You draw it up long, then bring it down quickly.

approach.label: Approach
approach.headline: The rhythm for shots around the green
approach.detail: The backswing takes twice as long as the downswing.

putting.label: Putting
putting.headline: The rhythm for your putting stroke
putting.detail: The backstroke takes twice as long as the forward stroke.

preset-3-1.description: Slow going up, precise coming down

preset-2-5-1.description: Not much difference between going up and coming down

preset-3-5-1.description: Long going up, quick coming down

preset-approach-2-1.description: 2:1 rhythm for shots around the green (pitch, chip, bunker)
